svg.text: Dynamic: negotiating a contract and transferring data
A consumer and a provider, each a portitor-connector with its portitor-identity: catalog, contract negotiation to FINALIZED and a pull transfer (DSP 2025-1), every DSP request checked with DCP
6. Caller check (ADR 0016): ID token against the caller's DID
document; presentation and credentials; issuer in
PORTITOR_TRUSTED_ISSUERS; status list bit not set
11. Caller check as in 3 to 6. Offer is the catalog's; its
permissions hold now for this caller (dateTime, credential
constraints: more scopes, ADR 0019); saves REQUESTED,
19. Caller check; a FINALIZED agreement held by the caller
whose permissions hold; the data plane starts a flow with a
new bearer token (only its hash is kept)
21. Keeps the data address, token included,
26. The body, streamed with its Content-Type

C4 model, dynamic diagram. Numbers give the order; dashed arrows are answers. Every DSP message, either way, carries a new token from the sender's STS and is checked like 3 to 6 (callbacks by the consumer, against the provider's identity); those calls are drawn only for the first. Each connector saves a

message before sending it and sends it again after a restart (ADR 0007). Portitor has no consumer catalog call: the consumer's own system reads the catalog (the demo takes a token from the consumer's STS).
